name: cprima's dev env
why: What belongs to one phone and the apps on it, not to the fixture and not to the test. The default apps (dialer, browser, mailer, sms, home screen) are DETECTED from Android's roles and intent handlers at the start of a run and recorded in the report. The apps of this phone are the systems in the folder cprima-dev/ next to this file, one file each, with their elements; a detected app without such a file fails with its package name. Another phone means another profile and another folder, selected with --environment.

android.resolver.apps.why: The instances of a list in the object repository, as seen on THIS phone. The repository says what a list is (a list of rows, 0 or more); this says what it held.
android.resolver.apps.observed_on: 2026-10-02, opened directly with `am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d tel:...`
android.resolver.apps.complete_because: the list moved by 150 px on the first scroll, and a second scroll showed no new row
android.resolver.apps.in_view_first: four rows in full; Zoom was under the Just once / Always bar until the list moved

preconditions.why: Without KeePassDX's Screenshot mode every screenshot is black (the window is marked secure), and a run without evidence has no use.

KeePassDX shows one-time hint overlays (TapTargetView) on first visit of a screen. An overlay blocks every tap, so a run with hints pending stalls. The rule holds when the hints setting is off, or when every hint of the screens a run visits was shown already (kdbxeducation.xml). education_copy_username_key is left out on purpose: it fires only on an entry with a username, which no fixture entry has (and it never fired in all earlier runs). Verified and recorded only: the test never changes any setting.
The locators by text (Unlock, Navigate up, Discard changes?, Modifiable) and the OCR assume English.

restoreAtEndWhy: Switching the User Verification toggle on the unlock screen also stores the choice as the app-wide default for every database. The test changes it for the fixture, so it is read before Initialize and put back at End. Nothing else is written.
